primitives.name: Defensive Demoralization Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: Most of us have seen defensive teams whose forwards have been demoralized by the failure of the backs in defending against the pass.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D': 'dimensionless index of team morale degradation', 'F': 'forward player count', 'B': 'back player count'}
primitives.assumptions: Demoralization is a function of back performance failure and forward psychological resilience.
primitives.breakdown_regime: D → ∞ as B's defensive success rate drops below threshold.

layer2.mapping: GSI models D as a latent variable in Bayesian belief networks; GSE tracks F/B ratio during transition states.
layer2.telemetry: Team morale metrics, defensive success rate, and player confidence indicators.

primitives.name: Passing Efficiency Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: PRINCIPLES OF PASSING There are certain principles in forward passing which have been established by experience: (a) The pass is thrown best by the No.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_p': 'passing efficiency scalar', 'T': 'time available to passer', 'P_3': 'position of No. 3 back'}
primitives.assumptions: Passer position P_3 maximizes T and minimizes interception risk.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E_p → 0 when T < τ_min or P_3 is obstructed.

layer2.mapping: GSI maps E_p to probabilistic passer effectiveness; GSE models P_3 as a control state in motion planning.
layer2.telemetry: Pass completion rate, passer time-to-throw, and spatial coverage metrics.

primitives.name: Lob Pass Optimization Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) The pass should be a traveling lob, not a shoot.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f_l': 'lob trajectory function', 'f_s': 'shoot trajectory function', 'σ': 'standard deviation of pass accuracy'}
primitives.assumptions: Lob trajectories minimize σ compared to shoot trajectories under same conditions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: σ_l > σ_s when f_l is applied vs. f_s.

layer2.mapping: GSI uses f_l to model pass accuracy variance; GSE applies f_l in kinematic path optimization.
layer2.telemetry: Pass accuracy variance, receiver catch probability, and trajectory smoothness.
